description: Golden cases for search matching (docs/data-contract.md#search). Run by pytest (apps/api) and vitest (apps/web). `expect` is the full ordered list of matching ids. Error codes are not given; they are extracted from `body` (bold text at the start of a list item under a 'Quick help' heading).

error_code_cases.body:
## Quick help
- **E15**: water in the base
- **OE** drain blocked
- Not draining: rinse the filter

## Notes
- **NOT** a code

### quick HELP
* **U4:** units lost contact

#### Sub heading
- **F1**: still inside quick help

## Other
- **X9**: outside

No headings
- **E1**: not under quick help

items.name: Dishwasher
items.body:
## Quick help
- **E15**: water in the base. Unplug, tilt it back, dry it, check the hoses for leaks
- Not draining: twist out the filter at the bottom and rinse it

## Maintenance log
- 2026-09-15 Technician replaced the drain pump (85 €)

## Notes
Uses 3-in-1 tabs.

## Quick help

items.name: Washing machine
items.body:
## Quick help
- **OE**: drain blocked. Open the small flap bottom right, clean the filter
- **UE**: load unbalanced. Spread out the clothes
